title: Payment-Record Relief on Home Comfort Financing Late Fees
content:
*Care centre training notes — Home Comfort Financing late fees and the borrower's payment record.*

**What is the late-fee payment-record relief?**
The late-fee payment-record relief counts the payments posted on the account less than 12 whole months before the date of handling, less the returned payments posted in that time. It is 10 percent when that count is at least 12, 5 percent when the count is at least 6 but below 12, and zero when the count is below 6.

**Which entries are counted?**
Every payment entry posted in those 12 whole months counts as one, whatever its amount or method; every returned-payment entry posted in the same 12 whole months takes one away.

| Payments less returned payments, last 12 whole months | Late-fee payment-record relief |
|---|---|
| 12 or more | 10 percent |
| 6 to 11 | 5 percent |
| 5 or fewer | zero |

**How does the relief reach the fee?**
It is one of the late-fee reliefs that make up the late-fee relief percentage. The late-fee reliefs are added together and the scheduled late fee is reduced once by that total; the reliefs never act one after another.

**Worked cases (hypothetical accounts)**

| Payments posted | Returned payments posted | Count | Relief |
|---|---|---|---|
| 12 | 0 | 12 | 10 percent |
| 13 | 2 | 11 | 5 percent |
| 7 | 1 | 6 | 5 percent |
| 6 | 1 | 5 | zero |

**A borrower made a payment that was later returned. Does it help the record?**
No. The payment adds one and its returned-payment entry, if posted in the same 12 whole months, takes one away.
